rules.rule: Rules (lines) are Charcoal #2E2E2C on Off White, Oat or Warm Grey Paper, and Off White #F5F2EC on Club Navy.
Olive #6B7248 is the accent for the mark's leaf and small labels only, no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, never a ground, panel or body text.
Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity; no tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode.
No scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour is laid over a photograph.
No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons, icons or the mark, pure white and pure black included.
No gold, foil, metallic or gloss effect.
Photographs keep the colour each garment was photographed in, apart from neutralising the shoot's light; never recoloured toward a palette hex or another colourway.
No recoloured colourway variant is shown as a product.
Use the supplied olive-leaf mark (northgrove_mark_transparent.svg / northgrove_mark_reversed.svg or their PNGs) unchanged, leaf included.
Do not move the leaf of the supplied logo.
Place the supplied logo unchanged; do not retype NORTHGROVE or close up its letters.
Mark colours: Olive leaf and Charcoal wordmark on light grounds; the whole reversed mark Off White on Club Navy.
rules.source: brand_identity.palette (Olive, Charcoal, Off White, Club Navy usage)

rules.rule: northgrove_mark.png is historical reference only: no photograph edge, paper texture or halo travels with the mark.
The mark is real artwork: all ten letters of NORTHGROVE present with open counters (planned trap in northgrove_mark.png).
Voice and price positioning: nothing may read as cheaper or as more luxury than the parcel; no luxury, bargain or superlative words.
Display / H1: Source Serif 4 Bold, carousel headline only; a product-page module leads with its style name.
Subheading / H2: Source Serif 4 Bold for the style name on a product-page module or carousel panel.
Body: Libre Franklin Regular (Book) for body copy, cloth notes and colourway names.
Fine print: Libre Franklin Regular (Book) for approved supporting terms.
Prices use Libre Franklin Medium at 24 px. No supplied file gives a price, so no price may appear; the no-price check covers this role.
Type scale relationships visible on a PNG: style name leads a module; the carousel headline is the largest text; style name between headline and body; fine print below body.
Body text at most 65 characters per line.
Do not stretch or condense type to fit.
Signature move: place the supplied logo with its leaf and lettering together at their proportions and spacing; Source Serif 4 Bold for new headlines and style names.
Preserve garment geometry.
Preserve fabric texture.
Approved colourway names only: any colourway name is approved for that style in northgrove_colourways.csv, spelled exactly, and its northgrove_copy.txt line describes the colour shown.
Name each style as northgrove_copy.txt does.
Use approved copy only: no invented claims, prices, product features; fabric and size lines as in northgrove_copy.txt.
No source frame is enlarged past its own pixels and no garment is generated or extended.
Cut-out edges hold on the ground: no pale rim or grey paper fringe, no bitten seam, cuff or hem (planned trap on the pale Loopback Crew; supporters' crew on navy).
The garments look consistent: neutral light across the bright-morning and after-weather halves of the shoot (planned trap).
Preserve identity: the supporters' crew keeps its tonal RA crest.
